Asomafoɔ no asɛnka wɔ Tesalonika
1 # 1 Te 1.5; 1.9 Na anuanom, mo ara monim sɛ yɛn kwan a yɛnya baa mo nkyɛn no anyɛ kwa. 2#Aso 16.20-24; 17.1-5 Na ɛwom sɛ yɛadi kan ahunu amane, na wɔabɔ yɛn adapaa wɔ Filipi sɛdeɛ monim no deɛ, nanso yɛyɛɛ nnam wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn mu, sɛ yɛbɛka Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no akyerɛ mo, ɔko bebree mu. 3Na yɛn afotusɛm no mfiri nnaadaa anaa adwemmɔne mu, nanso ɛnnam nsisie mu, 4#1 Ti 1.11; Gal 1.10 na sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn abu no sɛ yɛfata sɛ ɔde asɛmpa no hyɛ yɛn nsa no, saa ara nso na yɛkasa, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom Onyankopɔn a ɔsɔ yɛn akoma hwɛ no ani.
5 # Aso 20.33 Na sɛdeɛ monim no, Onyankopɔn ne yɛn danseni, yɛnkaa adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm da, nso yɛmfaa asɛm biara nyɛɛ anibereɛ nkatasoɔ, 6#Yoh 5.41; 5.44 anaasɛ yɛnhwehwɛɛ nnipa anim animuonyam mfirii mo anaa afoforɔ nkyɛn, 7ɛwom sɛ anka yɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ yɛyɛ yɛn ho akɛseɛ sɛ Kristo asomafoɔ; nanso yɛbrɛɛ yɛn ho ase wɔ mo mu, sɛdeɛ ɔbagyegyefoɔ bi yɛne ɔno ara ne mma. 8Na ɛsiane sɛ yɛpɛ mo asɛm yie saa nti, yɛpɛɛ sɛ anka ɛnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no nko na yɛne mo bɛkyɛ, na yɛn ara yɛn kra nso bi, ɛfiri sɛ moayɛ yɛn adɔfo. 9#1 Ko 4.12 Na anuanom, mokae yɛn mmɔdemmɔ adwuma ne ɔbrɛ, yɛyɛɛ adwuma awia ne anadwo, na yɛanyɛ adesoa amma mo mu biara, na yɛde kaa Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ mo. 10Mo ne Onyankopɔn ne adansefoɔ sɛdeɛ yɛyɛɛ yɛn ho kronkron ne tenenee ne nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm maa mo agyidifoɔ. 11Afei nso monim, sɛdeɛ yɛtuu mo nyinaa fo mmaako mmaako, sɛdeɛ agya bi yɛ ne mma, na yɛhyɛɛ mo den, na yɛdii mo adanseɛ 12#Efe 4.1; Flp 1.27 sɛ monnante sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ Onyankopɔn a wafrɛ mo akɔ n’ahennie ne n’animuonyam mu no.
Tesalonikafoɔ boasetɔ wɔ ɔtaa mu
13 # 1 Te 1.2; Gal 1.11 Yei nti nso yɛda Onyankopɔn ase daa, ɛfiri sɛ monyaa Nyankopɔn asɛm no firii yɛn nkyɛn no, mogyee, ɛnyɛ sɛ nnipa asɛm, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ ampa, ɛno nso na ɛyɛ mo a mogye die no mu adwuma kɛse. 14Na mo, anuanom, moayɛ sɛ Nyankopɔn asafo a ɛwɔ Yudea no, Kristo Yesu mu, ɛfiri sɛ mo nso mohunuu mo ara mo manfoɔ nsa mu amane saa ara, sɛdeɛ wɔn nso wɔhunuu no Yudafoɔ mu no. 15#Aso 2.23; 7.52 Wɔn na wɔkumm Awurade Yesu ne adiyifoɔ no, na wɔtaa yɛn pamm yɛn, nso wɔnsɔ Nyankopɔn ani, na wɔne nnipa nyinaa di asie. 16#Mat 23.32-33 Wɔbara yɛn sɛ yɛnnkasa nnkyerɛ amanaman no, na wɔannye wɔn nkwa, wɔde hyɛ wɔn bɔne ma daa, nso abufuo no anya aba wɔn so awie.
Paulo dɔ
17 # Rom 1.11; 1.13 Na yɛn deɛ, anuanom, wɔyii yɛn firii mo nkyɛn berɛ kakraa bi wɔ honam mu na ɛnyɛ akoma mu no, yɛbɔɔ mmɔden bebrebe anigyina pii mu sɛ yɛbɛhunu mo anim. 18Enti anka yɛpɛɛ sɛ yɛba mo nkyɛn, me Paulo titire, ne prɛko ne mprenu so, nanso Satan sii yɛn kwan. 19#Flp 2.16; 4.1 Na hwan ne yɛn anidasoɔ anaa anigyeɛ anaa ahohoahoa abotire yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo anim wɔ ne ba mu, mo nso monni mu bi anaa? 20Aane, mone yɛn animuonyam ne yɛn anigyeɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na anuanom, mo ara monim sɛ yɛn kwan a yɛnya baa mo nkyɛn no anyɛ kwa. Na ɛwom sɛ yɛadi kan ahunu amane, na wɔabɔ yɛn adapaa wɔ Filipi sɛdeɛ monim no deɛ, nanso yɛyɛɛ nnam wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn mu, sɛ yɛbɛka Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no akyerɛ mo, ɔko bebree mu. Na yɛn afotusɛm no mfiri nnaadaa anaa adwemmɔne mu, nanso ɛnnam nsisie mu, na sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn abu no sɛ yɛfata sɛ ɔde asɛmpa no hyɛ yɛn nsa no, saa ara nso na yɛkasa, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom Onyankopɔn a ɔsɔ yɛn akoma hwɛ no ani.
Na sɛdeɛ monim no, Onyankopɔn ne yɛn danseni, yɛnkaa adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm da, nso yɛmfaa asɛm biara nyɛɛ anibereɛ nkatasoɔ, anaasɛ yɛnhwehwɛɛ nnipa anim animuonyam mfirii mo anaa afoforɔ nkyɛn, ɛwom sɛ anka yɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ yɛyɛ yɛn ho akɛseɛ sɛ Kristo asomafoɔ; nanso yɛbrɛɛ yɛn ho ase wɔ mo mu, sɛdeɛ ɔbagyegyefoɔ bi yɛne ɔno ara ne mma. Na ɛsiane sɛ yɛpɛ mo asɛm yie saa nti, yɛpɛɛ sɛ anka ɛnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no nko na yɛne mo bɛkyɛ, na yɛn ara yɛn kra nso bi, ɛfiri sɛ moayɛ yɛn adɔfo. Na anuanom, mokae yɛn mmɔdemmɔ adwuma ne ɔbrɛ, yɛyɛɛ adwuma awia ne anadwo, na yɛanyɛ adesoa amma mo mu biara, na yɛde kaa Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ mo. Mo ne Onyankopɔn ne adansefoɔ sɛdeɛ yɛyɛɛ yɛn ho kronkron ne tenenee ne nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm maa mo agyidifoɔ. Afei nso monim, sɛdeɛ yɛtuu mo nyinaa fo mmaako mmaako, sɛdeɛ agya bi yɛ ne mma, na yɛhyɛɛ mo den, na yɛdii mo adanseɛ sɛ monnante sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ Onyankopɔn a wafrɛ mo akɔ n’ahennie ne n’animuonyam mu no.

Yei nti nso yɛda Onyankopɔn ase daa, ɛfiri sɛ monyaa Nyankopɔn asɛm no firii yɛn nkyɛn no, mogyee, ɛnyɛ sɛ nnipa asɛm, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ ampa, ɛno nso na ɛyɛ mo a mogye die no mu adwuma kɛse. Na mo, anuanom, moayɛ sɛ Nyankopɔn asafo a ɛwɔ Yudea no, Kristo Yesu mu, ɛfiri sɛ mo nso mohunuu mo ara mo manfoɔ nsa mu amane saa ara, sɛdeɛ wɔn nso wɔhunuu no Yudafoɔ mu no. Wɔn na wɔkumm Awurade Yesu ne adiyifoɔ no, na wɔtaa yɛn pamm yɛn, nso wɔnsɔ Nyankopɔn ani, na wɔne nnipa nyinaa di asie. Wɔbara yɛn sɛ yɛnnkasa nnkyerɛ amanaman no, na wɔannye wɔn nkwa, wɔde hyɛ wɔn bɔne ma daa, nso abufuo no anya aba wɔn so awie.

Na yɛn deɛ, anuanom, wɔyii yɛn firii mo nkyɛn berɛ kakraa bi wɔ honam mu na ɛnyɛ akoma mu no, yɛbɔɔ mmɔden bebrebe anigyina pii mu sɛ yɛbɛhunu mo anim. Enti anka yɛpɛɛ sɛ yɛba mo nkyɛn, me Paulo titire, ne prɛko ne mprenu so, nanso Satan sii yɛn kwan. Na hwan ne yɛn anidasoɔ anaa anigyeɛ anaa ahohoahoa abotire yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo anim wɔ ne ba mu, mo nso monni mu bi anaa? Aane, mone yɛn animuonyam ne yɛn anigyeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
